hero.title: Rooms for every trip.
hero.subtitle: Double or triple, standard or superior. Warm, well-equipped spaces with breakfast included, made for resting after a day out among the glaciers.

selector.title: Four types, the same warmth.
selector.description: Browse the photos and bed configurations available within each category. Whenever you like, check real-time availability and rates.
selector.accessibilityNote: Some rooms are on the upper floor, which is reached by stairs; the hotel does not have a lift. If you have mobility requirements, please contact us before booking so we can help you choose a suitable room.

cta.title: Check availability and rates
cta.description: Book directly on this site and always get the best rate, with breakfast included and instant confirmation.

section.bedConfigurationNote: These are fixed configurations within the category and are assigned subject to availability; not every room can be reconfigured.

doubleStandard.name: Standard Double
doubleStandard.blurb: Comfortable and practical, with either one double bed or two single beds depending on the room assigned and availability.

tripleStandard.name: Standard Triple
tripleStandard.blurb: For families or groups of friends. This category has two fixed configurations: one double and one single bed, or three single beds.

doubleSuperior.name: Superior Double
doubleSuperior.blurb: Carefully finished, with a renovated private bathroom. It may have one double bed or two single beds depending on the room assigned and availability.

tripleSuperior.name: Superior Triple
tripleSuperior.blurb: A comfortable option for families, with carefully considered finishes and a renovated private bathroom, without giving up the central location.
